title: The Deployment Succeeded.
subtitle: Deploy-time signals are proxies; users experience latency, errors and correctness

panels.heading: Pipeline Is Green
panels.caption: Build, tests, probes and the rollout all report success
panels.note: "Container is up" is not the same as "ready under real load"

panels.heading: Hidden Amplifiers
panels.caption: Cold caches, retry storms, blocking migrations and risky flags shift the envelope
panels.note: A tiny slowdown breaches timeouts; retries multiply load with no single failure

panels.heading: Users Feel It
panels.caption: Latency and errors rise while every deploy check stays green
panels.note: The gap is between deploy success criteria and user-facing SLOs

strip_caption: Encode SLOs into the deployment process so success reflects what users experience
